name: dos_lattice
about:
Lattice C 1.0x's DOS library (Microsoft C 1.03/1.04, 2.0x): as dos_c_early, but text mode (
 written 
 to text files and the console, read back as 
; creat/open's 8000h raw) and exit() leaving DOS no code (ERRORLEVEL 0)

notes._main: the command line was cut into words at spaces alone (no quotes); the C library of today cuts it its own way
notes.fopen: the old library had no text mode: every file is opened binary ("rb", "wb")
notes.kbdchar: DOS's buffered line input (function 0Ah): the line, a carriage return, a line feed; at the end of the input -1
notes.corein: the memory above the program's 64K: here pages of a block of the heap of as many pages as coremax says
notes.getdrive: the current drive (0 = A:); on a system without drives, C:
notes.longjmp: a longjmp without a value: 1 (the old one returned whatever was in AX)
notes.sopen: the sharing asked for is not kept (no other program shares the file)
notes.exit: the old library's exit(n) gave DOS no code: ERRORLEVEL was 0 whatever n was; so here
notes.getmem: getmem(n)/getml(n) give a zeroed block four times n bytes (the program asks by its 16-bit structures' sizes)
